title: Quantifying SMT Solver Instability for Formal Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.12649v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Program verification has become commonplace in software development projects, and much of its feasibility can be attributed to the potential of SMT solvers to automate model checking and other verification techniques. However, SMT instability, a phenomenon where semantically equivalent permutations of source code take much longer to solve or timeout, has been found to interrupt workflows and make software engineers more likely to avoid verification. Previous efforts to measure SMT instability have had difficulty quantifying it due to the abnormal runtime distributions it produces. In this paper, we use the coefficient of variation to model instability across an extensive dataset of SMT queries from three software domains. Our results show that SMT instability is significant in each area, and that it increases for queries that take longer on average. translated_title: 量化SMT求解器不稳定性以用于形式化验证
translated_abstract: 程序验证在软件开发项目中已变得十分普遍，其可行性在很大程度上归功于SMT求解器在自动化模型检测及其他验证技术方面的潜力。然而，SMT不稳定性——即语义等价的源代码排列变体需要长得多的求解时间甚至超时的现象——已被发现会打断工作流程，并使软件工程师更倾向于回避验证。以往测量SMT不稳定性的工作由于该现象产生的异常运行时间分布而难以对其进行量化。在本文中，我们使用变异系数来对来自三个软件领域的大量SMT查询数据集中的不稳定性进行建模。我们的结果表明，SMT不稳定性在各个领域都很显著，并且对于平均耗时更长的查询，不稳定性会进一步增加。此外，通过一种新颖的量化不稳定性的方法，我们展示了一种不同的方法
tldr: 本文使用变异系数及一种新颖的量化方法，在来自三个软件领域的大规模SMT查询数据集上量化了SMT求解器的不稳定性，发现该不稳定性在各领域均十分显著，且平均求解时间越长的查询不稳定性越强。
